_about: RATIFIED Company Standard CONF-MUTUAL-NDA-001 (AM-199, 2026-10-26). The position is Legal
Constitution §15's Company Position, quoted verbatim below — confidentiality obligations are mutual —
and its Unacceptable Position: 'A one-directional confidentiality obligation protecting only one
party.' Ratified with every Constitution position by AM-73; nothing in it is authored. A real NDA
titled 'MUTUAL' bound the Disclosing Party role to the counterparty by name and the Receiving Party
role to a blank, so only the counterparty's information was protected — read by its roles, never its
title (owner, 2026-10-26). PRESENCE: the evaluator reads no clause text; a role bound to a named party
addresses the requirement by departing from it, a DEVIATION for a person.
It is CONFIGURATION: no locked decision is amended.
description: Confidentiality obligations are mutual: each party protects the other's information.
source_document: Legal Mind — Legal Constitution, Lawyer Review Version L1.14 (docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.14.md)
source_quote: Confidentiality obligations are mutual — both parties owe each other the same protections, regardless of which party is disclosing information in a given instance.
